title: pqc-readiness endpoint observation, schema 1.0
description: One record of what a network-side tool saw an endpoint negotiate. Consumed by `pqc-readiness --aggregate DIR --observations FILE` (#149). A file is either an envelope object ({observation_schema_version, observations}) or JSON Lines with one self-describing record per line. Within major version 1, new minor versions only add optional keys; keys starting with `x-` are producer extensions and always allowed.

envelopeRecord.description: A record inside an envelope: it inherits the envelope's version and may omit its own.

id.description: Producer's own identifier, echoed in the join output.

observed_at.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit offset (`Z` or `+hh:mm`).

protocol.description: tls and ssh run over TCP; quic, dtls and ikev2 over UDP.

transport.description: Optional; when present it must match the protocol's transport.

fqdn.description: DNS name the tool connected to.

ip.description: Address the tool connected to. IPv4-mapped IPv6 is treated as IPv4.

sni.description: TLS server_name sent, when different from fqdn or when only ip is known.

negotiated_group.description: TLS / QUIC / DTLS: the named group (IANA name such as `X25519MLKEM768`, or its codepoint as `0x11EC`). SSH: the key exchange method (e.g. `mlkem768x25519-sha256`). IKEv2: the initial key exchange (e.g. `ecp256`, `x25519`).

additional_key_exchanges.description: IKEv2 only: RFC 9370 additional key exchanges negotiated (e.g. `mlkem768`).

offered_groups.description: Groups the endpoint accepted when probed, if the tool enumerated them. Informational.

certificate_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the leaf certificate DER. Secondary join key against certificates the scanner found on the host.
